/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
inputs = ['checks.mjs', 'yss-project.yaml', 'CONTEXT.md', '.template-spec/templates/verification-record-template.md']
def digests():
    return {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in inputs}
before = digests()
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
result = subprocess.run(['node', 'checks.mjs'], cwd=root, capture_output=True)
ended = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
(root / 'verification.stdout.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
(root / 'verification.stderr.log').write_bytes(result.stderr)
record = {
    'command': 'node checks.mjs',
    'argv': ['node', 'checks.mjs'],
    'cwd': str(root),
    'started_at': started,
    'ended_at': ended,
    'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'stdout_log': 'verification.stdout.log',
    'stderr_log': 'verification.stderr.log',
    'input_sha256_before': before,
    'input_sha256_after': digests(),
    'scope': 'test-data-only; local fixture verification'
}
(root / 'verification-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
sys.stderr.buffer.write(result.stderr)
print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
PY"
